notes: Wave 1A ('State/commands/view models') per blueprint/09_MIGRATION_WAVES_AND_PR_LANES.md and spec/pr-lanes.json lane 1A ('shared contract exports'). This registry is the single source of truth src/state/uiState.ts is hand-derived from, and scripts/check-ui-state-model.mjs cross-checks the TS side against. It defines the renderer-independent UI state snapshot shape (primary surface, modal surface, game/auth/connection/install phases, control/motion modes, effects quality) that both the existing Phaser MenuScene and any future DOM UI layer can consume identically, per the 'Phaser owns the world; DOM owns application UI' split (decision renderer-ownership-split). No file in this wave is wired into index.html, vite.config.ts, MenuScene.ts, or any other protected/live-render path -- per Wave 1's own acceptance criteria ('no gameplay/UI behavior change; old captures remain structurally equivalent'), the still-open PR83_PROTECTED_HOLD status of src/scenes/MenuScene.ts, and decision no-big-bang-menuscene-rewrite ('MenuScene.ts is decomposed through characterization and adapters, not replaced in one rewrite'). This is registration and shared-contract plumbing only, not a state migration.
